title: BCT: Bayes-Consistent Tempering for Flow Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.27641v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Temperature scaling is typically applied as a post-hoc transformation of model probabilities. In posterior-induced flow language models, this creates two mismatches. First, posterior tempering implicitly changes both the endpoint distribution and the distribution of intermediate noisy states, while the denoiser remains trained on the original states. Second, the tempered posterior weights are combined with transport dynamics derived for the untempered flow. These mismatches are reflected empirically: lowering temperature improves GSM8K performance much less reliably in flow LMs than in discrete diffusion LMs. We introduce Bayes-Consistent Tempering (BCT), which makes temperature explicit in both the distributions and dynamics of the generative flow. Its learned realization trains the denoiser on tempered intermediate states and tempers the endpoint distribution using the corresponding tempered dynamics. We also derive training-free var

translated_title: BCT：面向流语言模型的贝叶斯一致温度调节方法
translated_abstract: 温度缩放通常作为模型概率的事后变换来应用。在由后验诱导的流语言模型中，这种方式会造成两个不匹配。首先，后验温度调节会隐式地改变终点分布和中间噪声状态的分布，而去噪器却仍然是在原始状态上训练的。其次，经过温度调节的后验权重与为未经调节的流所导出的传输动力学相结合。这些不匹配在实证中有所体现：在流语言模型中，降低温度对GSM8K性能的提升远不如在离散扩散语言模型中可靠。我们提出了贝叶斯一致温度调节（BCT），它将温度显式地融入生成流的分布和动力学之中。其可学习的实现方式在经过温度调节的中间状态上训练去噪器，并使用相应的调节后动力学对终点分布进行温度调节。我们还推导了无需训练的变体（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出贝叶斯一致温度调节（BCT），将温度显式地融入流语言模型生成过程的分布与动力学中，解决了事后温度缩放导致的分布与动力学不匹配问题，使温度调节对流语言模型性能的提升更加可靠。
en_tdlr: Proposes Bayes-Consistent Tempering (BCT), which explicitly incorporates temperature into both the distributions and dynamics of the generative flow in language models, resolving the mismatches caused by post-hoc temperature scaling and enabling more reliable performance gains for flow language models.
